set.body:
Objective: make rfugw a focused, fast, scientifically trustworthy optimal-transport library: excellent linear OT, GW/FGW, unbalanced alignment, and selected scalable variants without pursuing POT breadth.

Epic acceptance criteria:
- All release-blocking correctness and API-contract tickets are closed with regression evidence.
- A small public balanced/exact/KL-unbalanced linear-OT substrate is certified and reused consistently.
- Clean source-tarball checks and hosted Linux/macOS/Windows plus sanitizer evidence pass.
- Flagship solver claims are guarded by answer-quality-controlled benchmarks.
- Documentation, metadata, terminology, dependency policy, and generated site match the shipping API.
- Optional capability is admitted only through explicit quality gates.
- Final 0.1 certification records commit, artifact digest, local checks, hosted checks, and remaining limitations.
set.title: rfugw 0.1 — trustworthy high-performance optimal transport
